passages.note: House Third Reading roll call shows Kolodin voting Y on HB2785, an omnibus election-administration bill (identification, canvass, recounts, ballots).
Bill status page names Kolodin as Prime sponsor of HB2785; the page prints no operative text itself.

passages.provision_quote: THE VOTER MAY CHOOSE TO PROVIDE IDENTIFICATION WHEN PRESENTING THE VOTER'S MAILED EARLY BALLOT, AND IF SO THE ELECTION OFFICIAL SHALL: ( a ) REQUIRE THE VOTER TO PRESENT IDENTIFICATION THAT COMPLIES WITH PARAGRAPH 1 OF THIS SUBSECTION.
passages.note: Enacted text (Sec. 10, amending 16-579) adds an optional in-person ID-verification path for mailed early ballots, one clause within a much broader election-administration act.

rows.reasoning: HB2785's identification clause (amending 16-579) sits inside a comprehensive election-administration bill that also rewrites signature verification, early-ballot processing, canvass and recount procedures; per the annex, an omnibus election bill that includes an ID clause is V4 multi-subject, and no source here shows Kolodin's own words tying his sponsorship or Y vote to that specific clause, so no passage establishes a chair on how the government should verify a voter's identity.
needs_source: Kolodin's own words (floor statement, explanation of vote, press release) tying his sponsorship or vote on HB2785 specifically to the identification clause in section 16-579
